answer: Admit new identities only through a lottery drawn per epoch from the dune queue: each applicant burns a non-refundable 2,000 POA ticket, and only 50 winners are admitted. A fake operator wanting 1,000 identities must burn 2,000,000 POA and wait at least 20 epochs, while an honest agent burns 2,000 POA once. Winners are recorded on the lotus ledger; if two winners share one funding source, both are revoked, their tickets stay burned, and the operator is banned from the knoll draw for 20 epochs. Limitation: a lottery still favours well-funded applicants over honest newcomers with little POA.
